info.name: MediQueue — Bulk Automático 100 Pacientes, 20 Doctores, 100 Citas, 100 Pagos y Notificaciones por Eventos
info.description: Colección automática para Postman. Crea 100 pacientes, 20 doctores, 100 slots de 1 hora, 100 citas, 100 pagos y valida notificaciones generadas por eventos RabbitMQ. No usa POST /api/notifications porque notification-service debe ser consumidor puro. Ejecutar con Collection Runner desde el primer request. Iterations=1. Recomendado Delay=500 ms o más. Base URL: http://localhost:8080 por API Gateway / api-gateway-lb.

const patientIds=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIds')||'[]'); const dentistIds=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('dentistIds')||'[]'); const slotIds=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotIds')||'[]'); const appointmentIds=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIds')||'[]');

const paymentQueryResults=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentQueryResults')||'[]'); const notificationAppointmentResults=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('notificationAppointmentQueryResults')||'[]'); const notificationPatientResults=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('notificationPatientQueryResults')||'[]');

const patientCount=Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('bulkPatientsCount')||100); const dentistCount=Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('bulkDentistsCount')||20); const appointmentCount=Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('bulkAppointmentsCount')||100);

const paymentsFound=paymentQueryResults.filter(r=>r&&r.found).length; const notificationsByAppointmentFound=notificationAppointmentResults.filter(r=>r&&r.found).length; const notificationsByPatientFound=notificationPatientResults.filter(r=>r&&r.found).length; const strictNotifications=String(pm.collectionVariables.get('strictNotificationChecks')||'true')==='true';

pm.test(`Se crearon ${patientCount} pacientes`, function(){pm.expect(patientIds.length).to.eql(patientCount);}); pm.test(`Se crearon ${dentistCount} doctores`, function(){pm.expect(dentistIds.length).to.eql(dentistCount);}); pm.test(`Se crearon ${appointmentCount} slots`, function(){pm.expect(slotIds.length).to.eql(appointmentCount);}); pm.test(`Se crearon ${appointmentCount} citas`, function(){pm.expect(appointmentIds.length).to.eql(appointmentCount);});
pm.test(`Se encontraron pagos para ${appointmentCount} citas`, function(){pm.expect(paymentsFound).to.eql(appointmentCount);});

if(strictNotifications){ pm.test(`Se encontraron notificaciones por appointmentId para ${appointmentCount} citas`, function(){pm.expect(notificationsByAppointmentFound).to.eql(appointmentCount);}); pm.test(`Se encontraron notificaciones por patientId para ${patientCount} pacientes`, function(){pm.expect(notificationsByPatientFound).to.eql(patientCount);}); } else { pm.test('Validación no estricta de notificaciones ejecutada', function(){pm.expect(notificationAppointmentResults.length).to.eql(appointmentCount);}); }

console.log('================ RESUMEN BULK MEDIQUEUE 100/20/100 ================'); console.log('Run ID:',pm.collectionVariables.get('bulkRunId')); console.log('Pacientes:',patientIds.length); console.log('Doctores:',dentistIds.length); console.log('Slots:',slotIds.length); console.log('Citas:',appointmentIds.length); console.log('Pagos encontrados:',paymentsFound,paymentQueryResults); console.log('Citas con notificaciones:',notificationsByAppointmentFound,notificationAppointmentResults); console.log('Pacientes con notificaciones:',notificationsByPatientFound,notificationPatientResults); console.log('===============================================================');
if(pm.execution&&pm.execution.setNextRequest){pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);}else{postman.setNextRequest(null);}
